_comment: Generated by converter/biomeconfig.py: every Middle-earth biome by land and region with the defaults of its cave settings. The game's config/lotr_port-biomes.toml is built from it.

settings.help: How much the 1.18 noise caves open up at the ground: 0 = never (caves stay closed under the ground), 1 = vanilla 1.18 (big open pits and many tunnel mouths). Only the top few blocks: the caves below are the same.
Ravines (vanilla's canyon carver and the port's mountain canyons): the share of them kept, 1 = all (vanilla), 0.5 = half, 0 = none.
Classic winding carver tunnels (vanilla's cave carvers and the port's mountain caves): the share kept, 1 = all (vanilla), 0 = none.
Ravines and carver tunnels stop this many blocks under the ground, so they cut through the underground but don't open at the surface. 0 = they may open at the surface (vanilla).
1.18 cheese caves: big caverns with stone pillars.
1.18 spaghetti caves: long, wide winding tunnels.
Lush cave pockets (moss, azalea, glow berries, axolotls) where this biome has them: how many against the default 1; 0 = none. Biomes without lush pockets don't have this setting.
Dripstone cave pockets where this biome has them: how many against the default 1; 0 = none. Biomes without dripstone pockets don't have this setting.
